title: 第72章 需要一万个刘济民
content_zh:
第72章 需要一万个刘济民-《文豪1978：从军旅作家开始》

翌日，阳光明媚，几缕白云悠然。379团的训练场上，战士们穿着崭新军装，整齐列队。依旧红旗飞舞，只不过这次少了肃杀之气，战士们也不必携带枪支弹药。
前面的红色背景舞台上，各连队的英模代表正依次接受慰问团首长亲自颁发的奖章。
刘济民站在三营前面，胸前挂着两枚奖章，分别是救人颁发的二等功奖章和出发前颁发的三等功奖章。
“授予三营营长吴建强一等功、七连杨富民一等功.....授予九连连长马贵生一等功、指导员刘济民一等功、副连长宋大根一等功、战士杨天旺一等功.......追认三营九连何小六为烈士，追授一等功，并追认为党员、追认九连战士庞军为烈士，追授三等功.....”
三营代表依次上台领取奖章，慰问团的余公和43军、127师的首长为大家授奖。
慰问团要前往多个部队，成员已先行分散。
“小同志，好好干！”余公从盖着红绒布的木盘上拿起奖章给刘济民戴上，又看了一眼此前获得的奖章，“不错，一二三等功都凑齐了，我期待你带给我更多的惊喜，听说你是从学校紧急召回来的？”
“是，首长，团里推荐我到中国医学科学院上大学，还没有毕业！”
“医学院，咱们距离不远呐，我还听说你小子医术不怎么样？外号‘兽医’？”
刘济民脸色涨红，旁边的马贵生等人听到后，疯狂下压着嘴角。
“怎么？在想是谁说你坏话是吧？”余公笑着看向旁边的章师长说道，“不是别人，正是你的师长。怎么？你敢骂吗？”
“绝对没有，首长！”刘济民看到章师长那不怒自威的眼神，大声地说道，“同志们对我的评价恰恰说明，我还有许多不足的地方，我一定认真接受！”
“哈哈哈哈，你小子，给你提个要求，医术要比周树人强点。”
“首长，那我已经超额完成任务了，我至少不会用阿司匹林治疗腰疼！”
鲁迅觉得“学医救不了中国人”，你以为是他真的不想学医吗？是他不行啊！要是鲁迅没有弃医从文，那中国就要多一个庸医了。搁到现代，医闹的家属能把鲁迅给撕了。
刘济民是“一壶热水包打天下”，鲁迅是“阿司匹林包治百病”，别说风寒、牙疼他吃阿司匹林，腰疼也吃。
“哈哈哈！”
“现在授予集体荣誉，决定授予六连‘英勇冲杀连’，授予九连‘能攻善守英雄连’！”
六连和九连的连长和指导员，分别上台从余公和其他首长手中分别接过了荣誉连旗。
“同志们，一支部队所取得的荣誉是由无数前辈的鲜血铸成的。铁军从北伐中走来，战斗在南昌城下，战斗在祖国和人民需要的每一处战场上。
荣誉来之不易，作为后辈务必珍惜再珍惜！同志们，别玷污了前辈用血换来的荣耀！”余公大声地说道，感情发自肺腑。

The next day, the sun was shining brightly, with a few white clouds floating leisurely. On the training ground of the 379th Regiment, soldiers dressed in brand-new military uniforms lined up neatly. The red flag was still flying, but this time there was no murderous atmosphere, and the soldiers did not need to carry guns and ammunition.
On the stage with a red background in front, the heroic model representatives of each company were receiving medals from the head of the condolences group in turn.
Liu Jimin stood in front of the third battalion with two medals hanging on his chest, namely the second-class merit medal awarded for saving people and the third-class merit medal awarded before departure.
"Awarded first-class merit to Wu Jianqiang, commander of the third battalion, and first-class merit to Yang Fumin of the seventh company.... Awarded first-class merit to Ma Guisheng, commander of the ninth company, first-class merit to the instructor Liu Jimin, first-class merit to deputy company commander Song Dagen, and first-class merit to soldier Yang Tianwang... Posthumously recognized He Xiaoliu of the ninth company of the third battalion as a martyr and awarded first-class merit posthumously, and posthumously recognized Pang Jun, a soldier of the ninth company, as a martyr. Posthumously awarded third-class merit..."
Representatives of the third battalion came to the stage to receive medals one by one. Yu Gong from the condolences group and the heads of the 43rd Army and 127th Division awarded everyone the awards.
The condolences group will go to multiple units, and the members have been dispersed first.
"Little comrade, do your best!" Mr. Yu picked up the medal from the wooden tray covered with red velvet and put it on Liu Jimin. He then looked at the medal he had won before. "That's right. I've got the first, second and third prizes. I look forward to you bringing me more surprises. I heard that you were called back from school urgently?"
"Yes, chief, the regiment recommended me to go to the Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences to attend college, but I haven't graduated yet!"
"Medical school, we are not far away. I also heard that your medical skills are not very good? Your nickname is 'vet'?"
Liu Jimin's face turned red, and when Ma Guisheng and others next to him heard this, they lowered their mouths crazily.
"What? Are you wondering who said bad things about you?" Yu Gong smiled and looked at Mr. Zhang beside him and said, "It's none other than your teacher. What? Do you dare to scold me?"
"Absolutely not, Chief!" Liu Jimin saw the calm look in Commander Zhang's eyes and said loudly, "The evaluation of me by my comrades just shows that I still have many shortcomings, and I will definitely accept it seriously!"
"Hahahaha, you kid, let me make a request for you. Your medical skills should be better than those of Zhou Shuren."
"Chief, then I have overfulfilled my task. At least I don't use aspirin to treat back pain!"
Lu Xun felt that "learning medicine cannot save the Chinese people." Do you think he really didn't want to study medicine? It’s not him! If Lu Xun had not given up medicine and followed literature, China would have had one more quack doctor. In modern times, the family members of the doctor would have torn Lu Xun apart.
Liu Jimin "conquered the world with a pot of hot water", and Lu Xun said "aspirin can cure all diseases". Not to mention cold, toothache, he took aspirin, and he also took it for back pain.
"Hahaha!"
"Now to award collective honors, we decided to award the Sixth Company as the 'Heroic Killing Company' and the Ninth Company as the 'Heroic Company Able to Attack and Defend'!"
The company commanders and instructors of the Sixth and Ninth Companies came to the stage to receive the honorary company flags from Mr. Yu and other leaders.
"Comrades, the honor achieved by an army is forged by the blood of countless predecessors. The Iron Army came from the Northern Expedition, fought under the walls of Nanchang, and fought on every battlefield where the motherland and the people need it.
Honor is hard-won, and as a junior, you must cherish it again and again! Comrades, don’t tarnish the glory that our predecessors paid for with their blood! "Yu Gong said loudly, his emotions came from the bottom of his heart.
